about: The hosted demo's clips (#118). demo/make_clips.py speaks each clip's sentences through the TTS service, turns the audio into a take with the a2f driver, and writes demo/clips/<id>/. Synthetic faces and voices only.
voice_licence: XTTS-v2 studio speaker (Coqui Public Model License 1.0.0, non-commercial), through agent-composer

clips.title: Hello
sentences: Hello. I'm a face made by argus-mask.
Give me any voice and I'll speak it, with my lips and jaw in step with every syllable.
Between words I blink, glance around and breathe, so I never freeze.

clips.title: How it works
sentences: Audio goes in, and a driver turns it into facial animation, thirty frames a second.
On top of that, I nod on stressed words, and my hands keep time with what I say.

clips.title: On a screen
sentences: A speech service talks, and every screen on the network that shows me moves in step.
Pick a face, a backdrop and a framing, from head and shoulders to full body.
